c1-9-001.gate_key: adv_can | C1 | mcq | Which sentence has a mistake? | She may not much experience, but she learns fast.

key.correct: She may not much experience, but she learns fast.
wrong: The flat may be small, but it's bright and quiet.
He might not be the fastest, but he never gives up.
It may well rain later, so take an umbrella.

item.why: *may not* + base verb: *She may not have much experience, but she learns fast.*
item.why_lv: *may not* + pamatforma: *She may not have much experience, but she learns fast.*
item.correct: She may not much experience, but she learns fast.
wrong: The flat may be small, but it's bright and quiet.
He might not be the fastest, but he never gives up.
It may well rain later, so take an umbrella.

c1-9-002.gate_key: adv_can | C1 | gap | Even with my glasses on, I ___ hardly read the sign. (can) |

item.q: Even with my glasses on, I ___ hardly read the sign. (can)
item.why: *could* (not *was able to*) with *hardly* and with *see, read, hear* at one past moment: *I could hardly read the sign.*
item.why_lv: *could* (nevis *was able to*) ar *hardly* un ar *see, read, hear* vienā pagātnes brīdī: *I could hardly read the sign.*

c1-9-003.gate_key: adv_order | C1 | gap | Such ___ the noise from the party that nobody in the street could sleep. |

item.q: Such ___ the noise from the party that nobody in the street could sleep.
item.why: *Such* + *be* + subject at the start: *Such was the noise that…* (= the noise was so great that…).
item.why_lv: *Such + be* + teikuma priekšmets sākumā: *Such was the noise that*… (= *troksnis* bija tik *liels*, ka…).

c1-9-004.gate_key: adv_order | C1 | gap | Write one word in each gap: Only when I got home ___ I ___ that my wallet was missing. (realise) |

item.q: Write one word in each gap: Only when I got home ___ I ___ that my wallet was missing. (realise)
item.why: *Only when* + first clause, then inversion in the second (with *did*): *did I realise*.
item.why_lv: *Only when* + pirmā daļa, tad *inversija* otrajā (ar *did*): *did I realise*.

c1-9-005.gate_key: adv_past | C1 | gap | By the time the doctor arrived, the patient ___ for over an hour. (wait) |

item.q: By the time the doctor arrived, the patient ___ for over an hour. (wait)
item.why: An activity that went on up to a past moment (*by the time the doctor arrived*): past perfect continuous, *had been waiting*.
item.why_lv: Darbība, kas turpinājās līdz pagātnes brīdim (*by the time the doctor arrived*): Past Perfect Continuous, *had been waiting*.

c1-9-006.gate_key: adv_past | C1 | gap | I wish you ___ me about the party. I would have come. (tell) |

item.q: I wish you ___ me about the party. I would have come. (tell)
item.why: A wish about the past: *I wish* + past perfect, *I wish you had told me*.
item.why_lv: Vēlēšanās par pagātni: *I wish* + Past Perfect, *I wish you had told me.*

c1-9-007.gate_key: adv_subj | C1 | gap | It is essential that every passenger ___ a valid ticket. (have) |

item.q: It is essential that every passenger ___ a valid ticket. (have)
item.why: After *It is essential / vital that*, formal English uses the base form (*have*) or *should have*; *has* is less formal.
item.why_lv: Aiz *It is essential / vital that* oficiālā valodā lieto pamatformu (*have*) vai *should have; has* ir mazāk oficiāli.

c1-9-008.gate_key: adv_subj | C1 | mcq | Choose the correct option: I insist that he ___ told the whole truth. | be

wrong: is being
to be
being

item.q: Choose the correct option: I insist that he ___ told the whole truth.
item.why: After *insist that*, the base form for every person: *I insist that he be told.*
item.why_lv: Aiz *insist that* pamatforma visām personām: *I insist that he be told.*
wrong: is being
to be
being

c1-9-009.gate_key: adv_subj | C1 | mcq | Which sentence has a mistake? | I'd rather you wouldn't have sold the car.

key.correct: I'd rather you wouldn't have sold the car.
wrong: I'd rather you didn't smoke in here.
I wish I had kept the receipt.
I'd sooner she hadn't told everyone.

item.why: *I'd rather* + past perfect for the past: *I'd rather you hadn't sold the car*, not *wouldn't have sold*.
item.why_lv: *I'd rather* + Past Perfect pagātnei: *I'd rather you hadn't sold the car*, nevis *wouldn't have sold*.
item.correct: I'd rather you wouldn't have sold the car.
wrong: I'd rather you didn't smoke in here.
I wish I had kept the receipt.
I'd sooner she hadn't told everyone.

c1-9-010.gate_key: adv_subj | C1 | gap | We'll finish this project on time, come what ___. |

item.q: We'll finish this project on time, come what ___.
item.why: A fixed phrase with the old subjunctive: *come what may* = whatever happens.
item.why_lv: Nemainīgs *izteiciens* ar *seno* konjunktīvu: *come what may* = lai kas *notiktu*.

c1-9-011.gate_key: adv_will | C1 | mcq | Choose the correct option: ___ that's about right, but let me check the figures. | I'd say

wrong: I would to say
I'd said
I'm saying

item.q: Choose the correct option: ___ that's about right, but let me check the figures.
item.why: *I'd say* makes an opinion less direct: *I'd say that's about right.*
item.why_lv: *I'd say padara viedokli* mazāk tiešu: *I'd say that's about right.*
wrong: I would to say
I'd said
I'm saying

c1-9-012.gate_key: adv_will | C1 | gap | There's the doorbell. That ___ the courier: I'm expecting a parcel. (will / be) |

item.q: There's the doorbell. That ___ the courier: I'm expecting a parcel. (will / be)
item.why: *will* for a confident guess about now: *That'll be the courier.*
item.why_lv: *will* drošam minējumam par tagadni: *That'll be the courier.*
